name: guichet
label: Guichet
description: Answers questions from the documents of the conversation, and can do nothing else.

variables.name: GUICHET_BASE_URL
variables.label: Address of a compatible server (Ollama, vLLM…)

variables.name: GUICHET_EMBED_MODEL
variables.label: Embedding model, for a search by meaning (bge-m3 by default on OVH; none = words only)

variables.name: GUICHET_INDEX
variables.label: Folder of the index (default: .guichet-index in the home folder)

variables.name: GUICHET_TONE
variables.label: Tone, in free text (e.g. « sobre et chaleureux »); empty = neutral and sober
